adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11
adds.text: On a Quinjet into space, Daisy tells Mack the team is her family, and he promises they will keep in touch. He then warns Sousa not to break her heart.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who calls the team her family. Mack promises to keep in touch.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Daisy's old friend, who promises to keep in touch and looks out for her with Sousa.
adds.evidence: Brand New Day: Mack and Daisy share a heart-to-heart on the Quinjet about Enoch saying this is the last mission; Mack assures her they will keep in touch, then gives Sousa a big-brother talk on her behalf.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
adds.text: A young Gordon brings Jiaying to Mack's team for help and flies with Mack to Afterlife, where Mack takes an I.C.E.R. away from him before Gordon teleports Coulson inside.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A young teleporter who flies with Mack to Afterlife to help Jiaying's people.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Director who flies Gordon to Afterlife and takes an I.C.E.R. from him.
adds.evidence: Stolen: Gordon teleports Jiaying into the Lighthouse meeting Mack assembled; Rodriguez, Mackenzie, Coulson and Gordon take the Quinjet to Afterlife, and Gordon handles an I.C.E.R. before Mackenzie takes it away from him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
adds.text: When Nathaniel takes Jemma onto a Chronicom ship, Mack flies after her with Daisy and Sousa and holds the Zephyr until she makes it back aboard.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mack flies into space to rescue from Nathaniel.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jemma's friend and Director, who flies into space to rescue her.
adds.evidence: The End Is at Hand: Mack, Daisy and Sousa dock with the captured Zephyr; Mack plans the rescue of Simmons and Shaw and holds off Chronicoms until Simmons and Shaw reach the Zephyr, then blasts their way out.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
adds.text: Fitz comes through a portal from the Quantum Realm into the speakeasy and is reunited with Mack and the rest of the team.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's closest friend, back at last through a portal.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's closest friend, there when he comes back through a portal.
adds.evidence: The End Is at Hand: the rest of the team, including Mackenzie, arrives at Krazy Kanoe; Simmons's ring opens a Quantum Realm portal and Fitz drops in, reuniting with the team.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
adds.text: Mack and May board the Chronicom ship together. Mack carries Kora to the controls, and May uses her empathy to stop the Chronicom attack.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who raids the Chronicom ship with Mack and ends the attack.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: May's friend and Director, who raids the Chronicom ship with her.
adds.evidence: What We're Fighting For: Mackenzie, Johnson, Coulson and May blow a hole in the Chronicom ship's roof; Mack brings Kora in and May sends the empathy signal that stops the Hunters.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
adds.text: Mack and Coulson raid the Chronicom ship together, and a year later Mack sends Coulson a rebuilt L.O.L.A. that can fly.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mack sends a rebuilt, flying L.O.L.A.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's friend, who sends him a rebuilt, flying L.O.L.A.
adds.evidence: What We're Fighting For: Mack and Coulson board the Chronicom ship together; one year later Mack asks if Coulson got his package, which holds the key to an upgraded, flying L.O.L.A.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
adds.text: Daisy finds Deke and Jemma in a cell on a Chronicom ship. Deke hugs her, and she gets them both back to the Zephyr.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A good friend Daisy rescues from a Chronicom ship.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A good friend who rescues Deke from a Chronicom ship.
adds.evidence: The End Is at Hand: Johnson gets to Shaw and Simmons, Shaw embraces her, and she sends them back to the Zephyr while she faces Kora.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
adds.text: When Yo-Yo loses her powers, Daisy tells her that Jiaying at Afterlife may know how to help, and Yo-Yo goes to find her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman Daisy sends to Jiaying for help with her powers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend who sends Elena to Jiaying for help with her powers.
adds.evidence: After, Before: Daisy tells Yo-Yo that Jiaying is at Afterlife in 1983 and may know how to cure Inhuman powers; May and Rodriguez are sent there.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
adds.text: A young Gordon teleports Jiaying into the Lighthouse to ask Daisy and her team for help against Nathaniel, then offers to take Coulson into Afterlife.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A young teleporter who brings Jiaying to Daisy's team for help.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent whose team Gordon brings Jiaying to for help.
adds.evidence: Stolen: Gordon teleports in with Jiaying while May is talking to Daisy; at the team meeting Daisy explains Malick's power theft and Gordon offers to teleport Coulson into Afterlife.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
adds.text: Daisy goes into a Chronicom ship to rescue Jemma, who at first does not remember her, and brings her back to the Zephyr.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's best friend, rescued from a Chronicom ship.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jemma's best friend, who rescues her from a Chronicom ship.
adds.evidence: Brand New Day: Daisy says she already has a sister to save, Simmons. The End Is at Hand: Johnson reaches Simmons, who hesitates and appears not to remember her, and they make their way back to the Zephyr.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
adds.text: Fitz comes through a portal from the Quantum Realm into the speakeasy and is reunited with Daisy and the rest of the team.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend, back at last through a portal.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend, there when Fitz comes back through a portal.
adds.evidence: The End Is at Hand: Daisy and the rest of the team arrive at Krazy Kanoe; Simmons's ring opens a Quantum Realm portal and Fitz drops in, reuniting with the team.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
adds.text: Daisy confronts May for keeping her sister Kora a secret, and May warns her that Kora already tried to kill Jiaying.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's trainer, who warns her about her sister Kora.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: May's trainee, who confronts her about a secret sister.
adds.evidence: Stolen: Johnson confronts May and questions why she was not told about her sister; May warns her that Kora already tried to kill Jiaying.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#9
adds.text: Caught in a time loop on the Zephyr, Daisy learns that Coulson has been reliving it longer than she has, and together they remove Jemma's implant and break the loop.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's father figure, who helps her break a time loop.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit, who works with him to break a time loop.
adds.evidence: As I Have Always Been: Daisy learns Coulson is also aware of the loop and has been in it longer; together they learn of and remove Simmons's implant, ending the loop.

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
owner_calls.question: Davis's only appearance in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7 is an LMD of him (S7#13), and Flint's is the Monolith's recreation of him. Should those count as Davis and Flint appearing in the title at all?
options: Count them as the same people (no change)
Do not count LMD or recreated versions as appearances
owner_calls.evidence: What We're Fighting For: Yo-Yo is in a car with Piper and an LMD of Davis; Flint is credited as the Monolith recreation.
